data-id="content-viewer"><div class="unp46"><div class="tzeth"><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="atf0a" id="viewer-atf0a" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><strong style="font-weight:700"><span>Progression meets Adventure</span></strong><span>
</span><span>
</span><span>We’ve noticed that many riders and busy students struggle to find consistent time on the water to truly progress. That’s why this Sri Lanka Kite Tour was designed to maximise your riding time and accelerate your progression — all while exploring one of the most exciting kitesurfing destinations in the world.</span><span>
</span></span><br role="presentation"/></p><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="7neei" id="viewer-7neei" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>Whether you’ve never touched a kite before or you’re already chasing your first jumps, this tour gives you the best chance to level up fast. Beginners will be riding confidently by the end of the week, intermediate riders will be boosting higher and controlling jumps, and advanced riders will be looping and spinning flat water lagoons.</span><span>
</span></span><br role="presentation"/></p><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="cqut" id="viewer-cqut" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>You’ll stay right on the water, where steady thermal winds blow day in day out. The best spots are a short boat ride away straight off the jetty at the resort. From flat-water lagoons perfect for learning to small waves and downwinders for the adventurous — Sri Lanka offers it all. Between sessions, we’ll stretch and recover, eat incredible delicious food, and enjoy the sunshine.</span><span>
</span></span><br role="presentation"/></p><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="4ikf0" id="viewer-4ikf0" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>We’ll capture your progress along the way with GoPro, drone, and camera footage — helping you fine-tune your technique and take home epic memories of you riding in paradise.</span><span>
</span></span><br role="presentation"/></p><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="6297k" id="viewer-6297k" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>Don’t miss out on this unforgettable adventure. Secure your spot now — and get ready for the ultimate blend of kitesurfing progression, culture, and exploration in Sri Lanka!</span></span></p></div></div></div></div><div class="sVraAat" From my experience, to have the best chance to safely learn to enter this sport you need three things:<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
1. Great instructors &nbsp;2. Good quality equipment &nbsp;3. The perfect location</span></span></span></span></span><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_5 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:18px; text-align:center;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:wfont_92906a_87f9b6dc4ffe48d7b76769bebe913a1d,wf_87f9b6dc4ffe48d7b76769beb,orig_alegreya_sans_regular;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:italic;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">These guys have all three and I have learnt more (and progressed significantly faster) in the last couple of weeks with them than I have in the previous 12 months with other instructors and friends.<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
Best money I have spent so far on my journey to becoming a competent and safe kiteboarder.</span></span></span></span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></section></div></div></section><section
